top_comments.author: @LogicPulse-v4l
top_comments.text: This is why open-weight matters. Run it locally, tune it yourself, and nobody silently downgrades your model.

top_reply.author: @STARTUPHAKK_sh
top_reply.text: That’s the real appeal for me — you get control instead of hoping an API stays the same next week. Being able to run it yourself and tweak it means you’re not at the mercy of random updates or pricing changes. What’s the first thing you’d customize if you had full access like that?

top_reply.author: @STARTUPHAKK_sh
